name: Cervical Kyphosis
definition: Abnormal reversal or exaggeration of cervical sagittal alignment producing kyphotic deformity, which may be congenital, degenerative, post-laminectomy, traumatic or iatrogenic.

investigations.principle: Standing cervical radiographs assess alignment; MRI evaluates cord compression; CT is used for bony anatomy when needed.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Postural/strength rehabilitation for stable flexible deformity
amber: Fixed progressive deformity with neural compression may require complex reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Greeva-vakrata phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Abnormal reversal or exaggeration of cervical sagittal alignment producing kyphotic deformity, which may be congenital, degenerative, post-laminectomy, traumatic or iatrogenic.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
